blocks.content: Besides the equator (0°), the North Pole (90°N) and the South Pole (90°S), there are four important parallels of latitudes.

rows: Northern limit of the Torrid Zone
Southern limit of the Torrid Zone
Boundary between North Temperate and North Frigid Zone
Boundary between South Temperate and South Frigid Zone

items: The Tropic of Cancer (23½° N) passes through 8 Indian states: Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, and Mizoram.
The midday sun is directly overhead at least once a year on all latitudes located between the Tropic of Cancer and the Tropic of Capricorn.
Areas beyond the Arctic Circle and Antarctic Circle receive slanting sun rays, resulting in the Frigid Zones with extreme cold climates.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Besides the Equator (0°), North Pole (90° N), and South Pole (90° S), four crucial parallels of latitude define Earth's heat zones.
The Tropic of Cancer at 23½° N is located in the Northern Hemisphere and passes through India.
The Tropic of Capricorn at 23½° S lies in the Southern Hemisphere.
The Arctic Circle is located at 66½° north of the equator, while the Antarctic Circle lies at 66½° south of the equator.
The region between the Tropic of Cancer and Tropic of Capricorn receives maximum heat and is classified as the Torrid Zone.
